# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
baseline_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {baseline_neg999}')

# Check assay_batch values
df['assay_batch'].value_counts()"}
